entries.summary: Hallucinates at 23.5% even when summarizing text it was handed (Vectara HHEM) — roughly five times the rate of same-size peers. Its fluent confidence makes this worse.

mitigations.note: Grounding helps but does not fix it — verify anything factual it produces.
For factual Q&A, use Gemma 3 4B or Qwen3-4B instead; keep Phi-4-mini for math and code.
